headline: Prime Minister Modi Discusses Security Issues During Bastar Diwali
seoTitle: PM Modi Comments on Naxalism During Bastar Diwali Visit
metaDescription: Prime Minister Modi celebrated Diwali with security forces in Bastar, sparking debate over his comments on Naxalism and criticism from the Congress party.
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited the Bastar region to observe Diwali alongside security personnel.
The Prime Minister stated that while Naxalism has declined, he believes intellectual figures continue to incite populations.
The Congress party criticized the Prime Minister for his remarks and the historical impact of the 2016 demonetization policy.
aiContextParagraph: Prime Minister Narendra Modi traveled to the Bastar region in Chhattisgarh to celebrate the festival of Deepavali with deployed security forces. During his visit, he addressed the status of local insurgent movements, noting that while the physical presence of Naxalism has diminished, certain individuals he described as "dimagi Naxals" or intellectual agitators continue to instigate the public. This visit coincided with the tenth anniversary of the 2016 demonetization policy, which prompted the Indian National Congress to issue a critique of the administration. Congress general secretary Jairam Ramesh characterized the Prime Minister's rhetoric as abusive and described the government's long-term economic and political strategies as damaging. The exchange highlights ongoing tensions between the governing party and the opposition, as both sides leverage the timing of the holiday and historical policy anniversaries to articulate opposing views on internal security and national governance.
whyItIsViral: The event generated moderate interest as political debate between the Prime Minister and the opposition Congress party escalated during the Diwali holiday.
